notes.title: KaveXplorer 0.13.8 Update is Live.
notes.content:
I have just pushed an update for the game and the update includes:
 + Character balance.
 + Improved saving system.
 + You now have to finish the tutorial before playing the game.
 + You now have to select your language on your first game launch.
 + Music.

notes.title: KaveXplorer 0.13.6 Update is Live.
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm supposed to announce this yesterday but I forgot to announce so...

I pushed an update for the game and the update includes:
 + Skill assist system.
 + Improved Boss fight.
 + Fixed dark knight (paladin) skill hitbox.
 + Better tutorial.
 + A teleporter system that helps you navigate around the map faster.
